items.author: Emily Sands, Head of Data & AI at Stripe, Nov 5
items.summary: Stripe's own agents now run almost all of its queries, dashboards, and analyses, and any business can connect Claude or Cursor to its Stripe data through Stripe MCP or the Queries and Reports APIs (examples: an always-on MRR dashboard, board-deck generation). Queries are free until Jan 31, 2027. 157 reactions, 5 comments, 10 reposts.

items.author: Sam Campbell, VP of Data Intelligence at Cambria, Nov 5
items.summary: After 9 years on Tableau his team is moving to Sigma, but he says the real win was rebuilding underneath: medallion architecture, a governed gold layer, dbt, and RBAC, all framed as getting ready to scale AI. 97 reactions, 5 comments, 9 reposts.

items.author: Joe Baratto, Enterprise Data & AI Architect, Nov 2
items.summary: He pointed Claude Dashboards at Looker's LookML semantic layer over BigQuery and had an interactive sales dashboard in minutes; his takeaway is that dashboards are now cheap, so trusted semantic-layer metrics matter more. 9 reactions, 1 repost.

items.author: Ruben Van de Voorde, Data Visualization Consultant, Nov 5
items.summary: How to test skills for AI agents: measure with and without the skill, re-test when models change, tailor community skills, and don't let AI-written skills add bloat (links a Tabular Editor blog). 17 reactions, 1 comment, 1 repost.
